description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationController class within the OAuth2 plugin module of OrangeHRM. The class handles OAuth2 authorization requests, validating authorization, managing user consent, and generating appropriate HTTP responses. It leverages external OAuth server libraries and internal traits for logging, user management, and HTTP request/response handling.

classes.name: AuthorizationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling OAuth2 authorization requests, validating them, managing user consent, and returning authorization responses.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 authorization HTTP requests, validating the request, processing user authorization, and returning a response.
